title: Finite evaluation of the proper/open system projection word
statement: For d,m and realized coefficient-system operations o,z, there exists a SystemTensorEvaluation b on all system inputs as in [def-sf-integral-projection-evaluation-factors]. For every compactified f:X→Y and integral constructible inputs K,L, the evaluated system compactificationProjection followed by evaluatedTarget d m b o f c K L equals evaluatedSource d m b o f c K L followed by the included finite CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component at the reductions. These endpoints are explicit composites of system tensor evaluation, system support evaluation, reductionEvaluation and the stage finite realizations. No integral tensor operation, integral support adjunct, sourceMap, targetMap, TensorComparison or integral projection map occurs.

source.place: Compatibility of the specified maps under successive coefficient reductions; integral reconstruction and proper counit normalization

proof.text: Prove the unrestricted intrinsic finite evaluation identity by the already proved private proper_projection_evaluation, open_projection_evaluation, pullback_evaluation_congr, evaluateSupport_hom_app and paste_support_word calculations of SystemProjectionFormulaCoherence. Reuse those proofs without the unused separated-structure-map and domain assumptions of its public wrapper. In particular the compactification equality cast and inverse compositor are retained.

Obtain the finite intrinsic-to-fixed tensor family e and its finite proper/open projection equation from the finite realization theorem. Compose the calculus evaluationTensor with e whiskered by evaluation.prod evaluation to construct b. No data are selected in a definition.

Apply the unrestricted evaluation equation to the two actual reduction systems. Postcompose with the finite tensor and datum comparisons. Naturality of e_X moves the pullback evaluation through the tensor; use the finite realization equation at the reductionEvaluation isomorphisms, then naturality of e_Y moves support evaluation through tensor. Functoriality of the two tensors combines the remaining endpoint factors, giving exactly evaluatedSource and evaluatedTarget.

theorem integralProjectionSystemEvaluation
    (o : Operations C.l E) (z : Realizations C.l E D o) :
    ∃ b : SystemTensorEvaluation (C := C) (E := E) m,
      ∀ {X Y : SixFunctorSpace D} (f : X ⟶ Y)
        (c : Compactification f.hom.left)
        (K : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E X.obj.left)
        (L : sfIntegralConstructibleCategory C.l E Y.obj.left),
        (evaluation (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
            (compactificationProjection C.l E o z.compositors z.openComparisons c
              ((calculus C.l E X.obj.left).reduction.obj K.obj)
              ((calculus C.l E Y.obj.left).reduction.obj L.obj)) ≫
          (evaluatedTarget d m b o f c K L).hom =
        (evaluatedSource d m b o f c K L).hom ≫
          (finiteInclusion (C := C) (E := E) m Y).map
            (CompactSupportFiniteProjection.component (stage d m) f c
              ((reduction d m X).obj K) ((torReduction d m Y).obj L))
